environment.backgroundWorkload: not isolated; no other applications closed

startup.scope: process launch through first FORMAL_CAMPAIGN_READY log observation; 50ms polling; isolated diagnostic new progress; not first interactive frame or ordinary existing-save load

firstBook.scope: title open handler through all requested portraits ready and end of rendered frame; three separate processes; no portrait preloading; uncontrolled OS cache; excludes process launch and GPU fence

garden.scope: one short run, 180 normal frames and 300 watch frames; isolated immediate diagnostic persistence

save.scope: Current Core SaveSlotManager including durable writes, checksum, two backups and read verification; System.Text.Json codec, not Unity JsonUtility or Player timings; synthetic receipt counts

limits: Non-visible book trial produced a black capture and no readiness marker; excluded from rendered timing. Process exited normally, not a confirmed antivirus block or game crash.
First observed hidden launch reached campaign-ready at 6581.3ms; visible restart series was already OS-cache warm. No OS-cold result is claimed.
Normal startup intro has up to 2.4s by source; diagnostics skip it. Not added to startup milliseconds as if it were an end-to-end measurement.

Save benchmarks use current Core SaveSlotManager and durable disk writes with two backups, but System.Text.Json codecs rather than Unity JsonUtility. Do not label them Player or end-to-end growth operation timings.
Synthetic additional receipts lack a long real-play battle/collection history; full late-game load/save may differ.
Minimum-spec and long-session performance not measured.
